senses.def: The subjective, unexpected feeling of having experienced something before, especially when that is not the case.
Loosely or humorously, anything one has done before or is being repeated.
ex: Have I done this before? Talk about déjà vu.

senses.def: To experience déjà vu; to see (something) as though having seen it before.
ex: Trees looked familiar, moments of landscape were perfectly déjà-vued.
